name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based 1-2 frame press and wave release input buffer.

hotkey.name: Stage Hotkey
hotkey.description: Key that cycles the buffer stage while playing (a letter, or Insert/Delete/Home/End/Page Up/Page Down). Shows an on-screen notice.

panel-hotkey.name: Panel Hotkey
panel-hotkey.description: Key that pauses the level and opens the Buffer settings panel while playing.

start-stage.name: Starting Stage
start-stage.description: Stage used when the game starts (1: 2/2, 2: 4/4, 3: 8/8, 4: 16/8, 5: CUSTOM, 6: OFF).

custom-normal-ticks.name: Custom Stage: Max Delay (all modes)
custom-normal-ticks.description: Maximum ticks an input may be delayed outside Wave. 4 ticks = 1 frame @ 60fps. Higher = more assist, but more delay risk.

custom-wave-ticks.name: Custom Stage: Max Delay (Wave)
custom-wave-ticks.description: Maximum ticks an input may be delayed in Wave.

normal-horizon.name: Lookahead (all modes, ticks)
normal-horizon.description: How far ahead the simulation checks for hazards. Higher sees more but costs more CPU.

wave-horizon.name: Lookahead (Wave, ticks)
wave-horizon.description: How far ahead the simulation checks in Wave (Mini Wave uses 50/65 of this).

spam-interval.name: Wave Spam Interval (ticks)
spam-interval.description: Inputs closer together than this count as wave spam.

spam-streak.name: Wave Spam Streak
spam-streak.description: How many rapid inputs in a row bypass the buffer in Wave.

ship-ticks.name: Ship Delay (ticks, 0 = off)
ship-ticks.description: Maximum ticks an input may be delayed in Ship. 0 leaves Ship completely untouched. Applies to both Ship and Dual-with-Ship.
